name: ahasignals-evidence-mcp
description: Read-only financial evidence: disclosure cutoffs, operating metric scope, cash checks and replay.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Read fixed package coverage, review clocks and source-health snapshot. Start here; different tools cover different company sets.

tools.name: query_disclosure_evidence
tools.description: Query retained and reviewed global AI disclosure evidence at a cutoff. Does not certify first-public availability.

tools.name: get_operating_changes
tools.description: List admitted operating annotations for CRM, ADBE, INTU or PYPL. A newly admitted record is not necessarily a new business change.

tools.name: trace_claim
tools.description: Trace an operating record to its source, capture and review clocks. Missing successor evidence stays unknown.

tools.name: check_cash_bridge
tools.description: Recompute a reviewed operating-pilot cash calculation with exact decimals. Requires matching period, unit and scope.

tools.name: review_claim
tools.description: Review cash evidence for the historical 12-company cash cohort. Does not cover all expanded global issuers.

tools.name: query_compute_commitments
tools.description: Read reviewed compute contract terms, payment conditions, linked claims and source clocks. Selected counterparty case; overlapping obligations cannot be summed.

tools.name: check_compute_cash_bridge
tools.description: Recompute a selected company cash bridge, preserving source, period, scope and units. Does not establish contract cash payments.

tools.name: replay_evidence
tools.description: Verify and recompute a saved packet using this exact bundled snapshot. Supply packet text and its separately saved SHA-256.
